mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of using a general contractor to coordinate subcontractors versus managing them myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a general contractor to coordinate subcontractors offers significant benefits over self-management. A general contractor brings expertise in scheduling, quality control, contract negotiation, and dispute resolution. They have established relationships with vetted subcontractors and can manage the complex logistics, permits, and communication required for a luxury project. This saves you time, reduces stress, ensures professional standards, and helps mitigate risks, ultimately delivering a more cohesive and successful project outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor provides expertise in scheduling, quality control, and logistics, saving you time and stress while ensuring a professional, cohesive project outcome.
